summary: Scaling and boundary screens for the melt/freeze ladder. Full record in SCALE_AND_BOUNDARY_TRANSCRIPT.md.

prerequisites: A current `swift build -c release` in the sibling HELUT checkout for tapes that invoke HELUT binaries or the prebuilt XCTest bundle
reproduce.behavior: Re-records a live execution. Timing-sensitive figures will differ between takes; the pass/fail gates and printed boundaries should not.
reproduce.workspacePathConstraint: The tape uses absolute paths under /Volumes/Code/MuleinLabs and must be adjusted if the workspace is relocated.

timingContext.interpretation: Elapsed figures visible on screen are local observations on one Apple-silicon host from the filmed take. They are not deterministic contracts and will vary between runs; the correctness gates and printed boundaries are the durable content.

claimBoundaries: Live run recorded during filming, not archived playback.
Fixture-scoped scaling observations on one Apple-silicon host.
No general synthesis, area, or depth claim follows from these screens.
